scrublet_review: Simulated distributions lack clearly separated modes; BM automatic threshold failed and peripheral automatic thresholds >0.45 fall in extreme tails. For strict training core use >0.25 as an explicit exploratory score-tail review flag, not validated doublet calls. Report 0.20/0.25/0.30 sensitivity; true capture-level rates/pool mapping unknown.

cluster_rationale.Lung:5: High Rora/Il7r/Icos plus Il18r1(85%), Tcf7(52%), Cd7(70%) and relatively lower mature ST2/IL2RA/KLRG1: maturation identity ambiguous, not declared contamination; deferred in strict core. Skin IL18R1/Ccr6 states retained because tissue-specific programs differ.
cluster_rationale.non_ILC2: Consistent cluster-level CD3, Ncr1/cytotoxic, CD79, Cldn5/Pecam1 or collagen/Dcn programs and weaker ILC2 evidence; exact evidence in cluster_marker_evidence.tsv and GSM top_markers.tsv.
cluster_rationale.BM: Separate developmental background; not all BM cells called precursors. No BM in mature peripheral core v1.
cluster_rationale.ILC2: Coherent Gata3/Rora/Il7r/Id2/Bcl11b and supporting receptor/effector genes, absence of coherent alternative lineage. Cell-level coexpression and weak evidence are reviewed separately.
